left.subject: TASK_524_mkpl: Marketplace section RPC rule
left.statement: TASK_2026_524 follows the Marketplace hub's standing rule that a section component mounts only while its section is active, so an unselected section fires zero RPC.

right.subject: TASK_524_mkpl: Marketplace provider registry
right.statement: TASK_2026_524 rejected keeping MARKETPLACE_PROVIDERS with three entries and a surface ref, since all three sections need bespoke child bindings and every entry would carry a surface nothing reads.

left.subject: TASK_533_b7e1: Resumed-run cost accounting
left.statement: TASK_2026_533 cost rule: the history prefix stays the JSONL aggregate; per resumed run compare the first result with the last cost-state, and if it is at least as large for every model and token class the run restored, so its contribution is R minus costState, otherwise R; a fresh run has base zero.

right.subject: TASK_533_b7e1: Cost authority flag
right.statement: TASK_2026_533 replaces the isDirectAnthropic branch with a per-query usageCostSource flag of 'reported' or 'unreported', so there are no provider-name branches in cost authority.

left.subject: TASK_538_3ccf: Surface submit while busy
left.statement: TASK_2026_538 busy rule: a surface submit is busy when the record has a turn in flight or a non-empty message queue, or a pending submit exists for that routing id; busy yields a rejected result with reason busy, no turn, values retained and revision unchanged, and a retry uses a new operation id.

right.subject: TASK_538_3ccf: Dashboard propose_spec tool
right.statement: TASK_2026_538 decision: ptah_dashboard_propose_spec stays with an unchanged name, input schema and text result, and a delivered v1 spec from a caller with a routing id is recorded in the same store and reaches the UI through the same surface push as v2.

left.subject: TASK_540_0940: Config surface workspace behaviour
left.statement: TASK_2026_540 user decisions: the pre-workspace branch renders a bare outlet rather than ptah-app-shell, and a workspace switch while a configuration surface is open keeps the surface on screen and re-creates its component.

right.subject: TASK_540_0940: Electron e2e verification choice
right.statement: At Gate 3 on 2026-09-23 the user chose the tester path for TASK_2026_540: senior-tester runs the Electron e2e and automates flows 1-4 where possible, while macOS and non-automatable flows stay manual for the user.

left.subject: TASK_555: Parallel lane pattern
left.statement: TASK_2026_555 rejected running parallel lanes per component against stubs, because that is exactly the pattern that shipped the broken #575.

right.subject: TASK_555: Orchestration tab state
right.statement: TASK_2026_555 rejected letting the orchestration tab keep its own ClaudeRpcService state, because it creates two sources of truth for agent:getConfig and writes that ignore data.success.

left.subject: TASK_560_2ae5: MCP toggle scopes
left.statement: TASK_2026_560 decision D1: MCP server toggles have global and workspace scopes, a toggle writes exactly one scope, and the effective value is workspace ?? global ?? default.

right.subject: TASK_560_2ae5: Ptah MCP default
right.statement: TASK_2026_560 decision D3: the ptah MCP server is ON by default and can be turned OFF only with a warning.

left.subject: TASK_561_9e57: Dependency-graph language scope
left.statement: User Decision 27 (TASK_2026_559, carried by TASK_2026_561): dependency graphs for Java, Rust, PHP, Ruby and C/C++ are deferred; those languages are disclosed as unsupported in graph answers, applying the lesson to disclose unresolved or partial results instead of guessing.

right.subject: TASK_561_9e57: Go vet integration spec in CI
right.statement: User Decision 30(b) (TASK_2026_561): go-vet-hostile.integration.spec.ts has never run against real Go, so a CI job with actions/setup-go must run it.

left.subject: TASK_576_e16a: Gate approval authority
left.statement: Standing authorization (user, 2026-09-29, TASK_2026_576): a gate that would ask the user for approval is decided by an independent lane of a different family (Glm and antigravity) and recorded; the orchestrator never commits or merges to main, pushes or opens a PR, bypasses hooks, or approves a removal outside the approved parity list without asking.

right.subject: TASK_576_e16a: Review cadence per phase
right.statement: Review cadence (user, 2026-09-30, 'Per phase', TASK_2026_576): batches get only typecheck, lint, scoped unit tests and the pre-commit hook; at each phase end one cross-side review lane reviews the phase diff, the full e2e set runs, and UI phases get a visual review; no early wiring, new UI stays unmounted until cutover.

left.subject: TASK_592_a44d: Workspace switching and sessions
left.statement: User decision recorded 2026-10-02 (TASK_2026_592): workspace switching must never end sessions, because multi-project switching is a feature; only closing a tab ends its session.

right.subject: TASK_592_a44d: PR workflow for TASK_2026_592
right.statement: User instruction of 2026-10-02 for TASK_2026_592: when the fix is finished, push the branch, open a PR to main, watch the CI jobs until they succeed, fix any failing job, and address CodeRabbit review comments.

left.subject: TASK_594_31ff: Dashboard spec versioning
left.statement: TASK_2026_594 does not introduce a dashboard-spec/3 schema version: the user chose one catalog bump only, and legacy dashboard spec versions remain supported (dashboard-spec/1 at catalog /1, and dashboard-spec/2 at dashboard-catalog/3).

right.subject: TASK_594_31ff: Lane git constraints
right.statement: TASK_2026_594 constraints: lanes never commit, commits end with the Claude co-author line, no bare git stash, and nothing is pushed to main without the user.

left.subject: TASK_595_1c01: MCP tool profile signal
left.statement: TASK_2026_595 rejected a ?profile=apps query parameter for the MCP tool profile because redactMcpUrl masks 'profile' as a secret so every URL log would hide the profile; the profile is a path segment (/profile/apps) instead.

right.subject: TASK_595_1c01: Profile signal source
right.statement: TASK_2026_595 rejected reusing surfaceMode as the Apps-profile signal because the harness builder also sets surfaceMode, so harness sessions would wrongly get the Apps tools.

left.subject: TASK_596_0a19: Lane stats scope
left.statement: TASK_2026_596 decision D1: show the quota windows of each lane and per-lane tokens, cost and model in the stats grid, while TASK_2026_535 keeps the full lane_runs ledger and model discovery.

right.subject: TASK_596_0a19: Lane spawn quota rule
right.statement: TASK_2026_596 decision D2: when a lane is near its limit, spawning warns and lists alternatives but still runs; ptah_agent_list and the spawn result show the window, reset time and lanes with room; estimated data never blocks.

left.subject: TASK_609_c495: Per-agent model settings scope
left.statement: User decision at Gate 1 round 0 (2026-10-03, TASK_2026_609): model settings use a machine-wide default plus per-workspace overrides; a save in workspace X changes only X unless the user edits the default on purpose.

right.subject: TASK_609_c495: Content-manifest update detection
right.statement: TASK_2026_609 defers content-manifest update detection (version badge and rebase from the silo) to a named follow-up task; Part B keeps only the existing rebase action for parity.

left.subject: TASK_610_6a10: ptah-ui authoring format
left.statement: On 2026-10-04 the user decided the coding agent authors visuals as a compact ptah-ui fenced block in its normal reply, not as a tool call; host-owned data is referenced by name, invalid blocks fall back to a code block, A2UI v0.9 JSON is accepted only at the boundary, and custom templates are deferred.

right.subject: TASK_610_6a10: ptah-ui rationale
right.statement: The reason the user gave for the ptah-ui fence in TASK_2026_610 (2026-10-04): agent output stays in context and is resent on every request, and JSON is about 60% syntax.

left.subject: TASK_597_ab22: Orchestration token rules
left.statement: On 2026-10-04 (fourth session of TASK_2026_597) the user approved five token rules for every remaining batch (relay a developer or reviewer at about 150k context or 60 tool calls, batches of about 6 files, orchestrator commits clean batches, Sonnet for mechanical roles, short check output); TASK_2026_613 then ships those same rules to every Ptah user and exposes them in Settings.

right.subject: TASK_597_ab22: Wave D scope
right.statement: In the fifth session of TASK_2026_597 on 2026-10-04 (Wave D) the user pulled S3 Batch 16 plus Tasks 17.3-17.5 into Wave D ahead of Batch 25 and chose 'Batch 16 + Tasks 17.3-17.5' for the setting keys.

left.subject: TASK_439_1310: Observation retention outcome
left.statement: Thoth phase 1 (TASK_2026_440, PR #513) added a daily retention job (processed observations after 7 days plus stuck-row quarantine), but TASK_2026_511 later found retention had never completed a run on one install because its wait ceiling consumed the 60 second wall budget.

right.subject: TASK_439_1310: Pre-migration snapshots kept
right.statement: On 2026-09-14 two older pre-migration snapshots (2026-08-25 and 2026-08-30, about 2 GB) were deleted from ~/.ptah/state with user approval and the 2026-09-09 snapshot was kept (TASK_2026_439 umbrella).

left.subject: TASK_599_8684: Raw-error handling scope
left.statement: For the Settings raw-error problem the user first chose option 1 (a per-handler catch, done in TASK_2026_555 Batch 56 for ptahCli:list and auth:testConnection); TASK_2026_599 (2026-10-03) is option 2, the repo-wide dispatcher guarantee.

right.subject: TASK_599_8684: Repo-wide raw error guarantee
right.statement: TASK_2026_599 is option 2 of the Settings raw-error work: a repo-wide guarantee in the dispatcher that raw errors never reach users, covering known raw-error sites outside Settings such as agent:permissionResponse and agent:stop.

left.subject: TASK_584_5e7a: Child session UI binding
left.statement: TASK_2026_584 user decisions of 2026-09-30: the earlier 'MVP has no UI tabs for children' was superseded the same day, so a child session binds to the UI automatically (real tab, session list entry, resumable, user can type into it) and hosts without a webview degrade to headless.

right.subject: TASK_584_5e7a: Child session spawning approach
right.statement: User decisions of 2026-09-30 (TASK_2026_584): approach A with new ptah_session_* MCP tools over an in-host ISessionSpawner calling startChatSession directly, unattended child permissions of auto-edit plus a Bash allowlist (outside the allowlist denied with a bounded timeout), and parent-to-child steering by messaging.

left.subject: TASK_404_6fcd: Compacted view and notification lane
left.statement: Decision record dated 2026-09-19 (TASK_2026_404): the compacted-view and notification-sound work still existed as unbuilt Track R items 2 and 6, libs/frontend/notification-center did not exist and no sound code existed in libs/**, so the R2 plus notification-center lane was opened.

right.subject: TASK_404_6fcd: Concurrent session target
right.statement: The user confirmed for TASK_2026_404 that the performance target is 25 to 50 sessions running at the same time, not merely open.

left.subject: TASK_586_2b3e: Activity feed parity removals
left.statement: On 2026-10-01 the user decided for TASK_2026_586: use antigravity and Glm for cross-side reviews with at most two lanes in flight (codex not used because of its usage limit), approve removing the skill-diagnostics accordion as a unit but keep the Candidates-by-status panel, and keep View logs relabelled Refresh.

right.subject: TASK_586_2b3e: Hot file rpc.types.ts
right.statement: TASK_2026_586 coordinator agreement with TASK_2026_580 and 584: libs/shared/src/lib/types/rpc.types.ts is a hot file, so a new workspaceRoot param goes as an optional field on the existing params type in the domain file under libs/shared/src/lib/types/rpc/, leaving rpc.types.ts untouched; a new method entry there is a last resort.

left.subject: TASK_615_04b0: Plan-limit follow-ups lanes
left.statement: User decisions carried into TASK_2026_615 (2026-10-05): add a short non-secret suffix from the hashed owner key to the owner label, use codex and opencode lanes for implementation with in-process subagents reviewing cross-side, and commit and open a PR when verified.

right.subject: TASK_615_04b0: Provider owner key privacy
right.statement: TASK_2026_615 rule: the Antigravity account value used as the owner key is hashed (only in provider-owner.resolver.ts) and never logged, returned or stored in clear text.

left.subject: TASK_613_8f34: Hard turn limit rule
left.statement: As recorded on 2026-10-04 in TASK_2026_613, a hard maxTurns limit in the agent definitions was only proposed and not yet approved as a rule; the five approved rules are relay, batch size, orchestrator commits, model per role and short check output.

right.subject: TASK_613_8f34: Orchestrator commit rule
right.statement: Rule 3 approved on 2026-10-04 (TASK_2026_613): when a batch report shows all checks green and no deviation to judge the orchestrator commits it after re-running only di-lint, degradation-audit and the scoped typecheck, while the team-leader keeps decomposition, deviation calls and phase completion.

left.subject: TASK_616_de8a: Antigravity live capture
left.statement: On 2026-10-05 TASK_2026_616 recorded that no Antigravity language server ran locally and the Antigravity app was not installed, so a live GetUserStatus capture was not possible and the reply shape stayed third-party (CodexBar) evidence.

right.subject: TASK_616_de8a: Git status timeout budget
right.statement: TASK_2026_616 Batch G (user request 2026-10-05) gave git status and numstat calls a 30 s budget, dropped the separate repository probe (exit 128 with 'not a git repository' is classified as not-a-repo), added a 30 s watcher backoff after a timeout that never blocks a user or RPC refresh, and added one follow-up push from the Electron git watcher when the window closes.

left.subject: TASK_377: TASK_2026_377 executor
left.statement: For TASK_2026_377 the user asked to orchestrate the fixes over two lanes with the Ptah CLI tool and not with subagents.

right.subject: TASK_377: Seshat role
right.statement: TASK_2026_377 decision D-B1: Seshat stays a content helper that drafts to files for a human to paste into the admin portal; the Discourse MCP and the two-key rule are retired and Seshat gets no direct API token for now.

left.subject: TASK_403_403b: Task id allocation rule
left.statement: TASK_2026_403 set the task-id allocation rule: scan origin/main plus every worktree plus the local folder, take the highest number plus one, append four hex characters, and the exclusive mkdir is still the lock.

right.subject: TASK_403_403b: Git port in platform-core
right.statement: TASK_2026_403 rejected adding an IGitReader port to platform-core because platform-core is a leaf with no child_process dependency by design and execGit already is the shared implementation taking the spawner port.

left.subject: TASK_433_d22a: Lane role delivery
left.statement: TASK_2026_433 rejected folding the agent role into systemPrompt because systemPrompt is the harness prompt, so the role would replace or be concatenated into it, and the ptah-cli branch never receives systemPrompt.

right.subject: TASK_433_d22a: Reviewer lane sandbox
right.statement: TASK_2026_433 rejected mapping reviewer read-only intent to codex sandbox_mode or opencode permissions, because every role contract writes a deliverable file such as code-logic-review.md and a read-only sandbox would make the lane fail its own contract.

left.subject: TASK_462_c819: Waitlist filtering API
left.statement: TASK_2026_462 rejected extending ListQueryDto and AdminModelConfig with generic filter arrays or date operators, because it changes the dynamic Prisma boundary for every model and forces unrelated callers to understand operator syntax.

right.subject: TASK_462_c819: Waitlist bulk approval endpoint
right.statement: TASK_2026_462 extends the existing explicit-id waitlist approval endpoint in place instead of adding a second filter-accepting approval endpoint, since the existing one already owns throttling, per-row transactions and the five-outcome response.

left.subject: TASK_491_e0da: Electron permission origin rule
left.statement: TASK_2026_491 rule 1: the trusted-origin match for Electron permission requests is exact on scheme and host, with no prefix and no substring match, and the two dev/prod origin values are recorded and pinned in a test.

right.subject: TASK_491_e0da: Electron null webContents
right.statement: TASK_2026_491 rule 4: a permission request with contents === null is denied by default; an exception needs proof that a necessary Electron-internal check depends on it, in which case only that exact permission is allowlisted and the proof recorded.

left.subject: TASK_511_c7b4: Retention never completed
left.statement: Root cause recorded in TASK_2026_511: on one install observation_queue reached 178,867 rows (878 MB of a 1.2 GB DB) because retention never completed a run, its governor wait ceiling being derived from the run's own 60 second wall budget so the wait consumed the budget.

right.subject: TASK_511_c7b4: Retention alert surface
right.statement: In TASK_2026_511 the user chose an in-panel banner for the retention alert and ruled out any host notification, toast or badge.

left.subject: TASK_533_b7e1: Resumed-run cost accounting
left.statement: TASK_2026_533 cost rule: the history prefix stays the JSONL aggregate; per resumed run compare the first result with the last cost-state, and if it is at least as large for every model and token class the run restored, so its contribution is R minus costState, otherwise R; a fresh run has base zero.

right.subject: TASK_533_b7e1: Resume cost correction
right.statement: TASK_2026_533 records a correction on 2026-09-23 to how resumed-run cost combines with the JSONL history prefix: an earlier claim that the SDK resets cumulative figures on resume was wrong.

left.subject: TASK_538_3ccf: Surface submit while busy
left.statement: TASK_2026_538 busy rule: a surface submit is busy when the record has a turn in flight or a non-empty message queue, or a pending submit exists for that routing id; busy yields a rejected result with reason busy, no turn, values retained and revision unchanged, and a retry uses a new operation id.

right.subject: TASK_538_3ccf: Stale revision asymmetry
right.statement: TASK_2026_538 intentionally treats revisions asymmetrically: an agent mutation with an old base revision is rejected as stale-revision and must re-read with ptah_surface_get_state, while a disjoint-path UI change with an old base is accepted; the asymmetry is pinned by tests.

left.subject: TASK_560_2ae5: MCP toggle scopes
left.statement: TASK_2026_560 decision D1: MCP server toggles have global and workspace scopes, a toggle writes exactly one scope, and the effective value is workspace ?? global ?? default.

right.subject: TASK_560_2ae5: Repository-declared MCP servers
right.statement: TASK_2026_560 decision Q1: repository-declared MCP servers default to OFF, with a one-time import of user-authored approvals.

left.subject: TASK_576_e16a: Gate approval authority
left.statement: Standing authorization (user, 2026-09-29, TASK_2026_576): a gate that would ask the user for approval is decided by an independent lane of a different family (Glm and antigravity) and recorded; the orchestrator never commits or merges to main, pushes or opens a PR, bypasses hooks, or approves a removal outside the approved parity list without asking.

right.subject: TASK_576_e16a: Stacked phase PRs
right.statement: On 2026-09-30 the user said 'lets stack the phases' for TASK_2026_576: one branch and one PR per phase, each based on the previous phase's branch, so work does not wait for a merge, and the main checkout stays on main with phase worktrees under .claude-worktrees.

left.subject: TASK_595_1c01: MCP tool profile signal
left.statement: TASK_2026_595 rejected a ?profile=apps query parameter for the MCP tool profile because redactMcpUrl masks 'profile' as a secret so every URL log would hide the profile; the profile is a path segment (/profile/apps) instead.

right.subject: TASK_595_1c01: Surface tools availability
right.statement: Decision (user, 2026-10-03, TASK_2026_595): the dashboard and surface tools belong to the Apps page only and other coding agents do not get them, reversing the earlier always-on decision of TASK_2026_493 and TASK_2026_538; a headless or coding caller loses the plain-text dashboard fallback and that is accepted.
